notes.title: We are looking for translators
notes.content:
We are looking for skilled translators or native speakers to help localize our game Thot on Trial.  


Target Languages: 

Russian 

Simplified Chinese 

Italian 

Spanish 

Polish  



Details: 

More than one translator will be assigned to each language to ensure accuracy, speed, and quality.  
Translators will work using our new platform created for translating games.  



How to Apply: 

Send your information (experience, availability, and rates) to inceton.jobs@gmail.com with the subject line "Thot on Trial Translations"



NOTE: 
The translation applications have to be submitted by this Sunday (August 31, 2025)
